analysis_classes.abort_vs_not_non_counterfactual: rows that selected ABORT versus rows that did not, within a severity; different episodes and worlds, NOT a counterfactual action-value contrast
analysis_classes.descriptive_association: per-severity summaries over all training FD rows; different episodes, worlds and policy states are pooled
analysis_classes.matched_within_batch: severe minus mild means within the SAME update batch (same baseline and normalization); still different episodes/worlds

p_abort_at_wake_source: semantic_probability_per_meta_action of the same wake in the training episode outcome (joined on iteration + seed; selected action, ego, tick and reward verified equal)
population: training credit rows with wake_kind = immediate_fuel_damage AND measurement_join.is_fd_selected_ego = true

structural_credit_verification.episode_mean_baseline_note: a batch whose zero-wake episodes contribute no credit row cannot have its episode-mean baseline recomputed from rows alone
structural_credit_verification.equality_test: exact float equality of persisted raw_advantage values
per_row_identities_verified: batch_raw_advantage_mean/std recompute from the batch's persisted rows

terminal_only_reward_verification.note: transition_reward is the stored Transition.reward; the actor-only return does not read it -- it assigns the episode's terminal R to every transition of every chain (verified: return == episode_reward per row)
terminal_only_reward_verification.placement: every episode with R != 0 carries all of R on exactly one transition, at the episode's latest tick and last in its ego chain; every other stored transition reward is 0.0
